decisions.summary: PROFILES files are matched to a stage by their -<stage>.prof suffix; otherwise the newest dev/perf-raw/*-seed<S>-hh<H>-<stage>.prof; otherwise profile_stage is run and the output says so
decisions.why: This is FR-001's lookup order. FR-001 does not say how a named file maps to a stage, and the suffix rule reaches old (sizeless) and new names alike.

decisions.summary: Each stage shows the 8 largest self times
decisions.why: FR-001 asks for 'the stage's largest self-time functions' and gives no count. Choosing 8 settles a detail the spec leaves open.

decisions.summary: Callers are ranked by the module's cumulative time under them; a call from the module to itself is not counted as a caller
decisions.why: FR-001 asks for the callers of the module ranked by the module's time under them. Every caller from outside the module is still listed. An internal edge's time also sits under the external caller above it, so counting it would count the same time twice and the ranking would no longer show where the module's time comes from. That reads 'callers' as callers of the module and drops nothing the spec asks for.

decisions.summary: The summary line labels the cross-stage share 'an upper bound' because cProfile inflates times
decisions.why: FR-001's closing share is still printed. The label adds a caveat and takes nothing away, and nothing is gated on it (FR-007).

decisions.summary: profile_stage names its raw profile <stamp>-seed<S>-hh<H>-<stage>.prof, with H the roll's household count (the reference's 15 when none is given)
decisions.why: FR-001 requires the -seed<S>-hh<H>-<stage>.prof name from this feature on. Writing the count actually used when none is passed keeps the name true to the roll.

decisions.summary: scripts/trial-start.py runs claim-feature.py, writes spec.md from trial-template.md with [DATE] and [N] filled plus a request.md stub, and prints the export lines as make claim does
decisions.why: FR-003: claim a number as make claim does and write the brief from the template. The request.md stub and export lines copy what make claim already does and add no behavior.

decisions.summary: The review gate passes a **Form**: trial spec without a verdict when its status does not open Done and git diff --quiet $RANGE -- l7r/ holds; otherwise the verdict is owed. The refusal names both conditions
decisions.why: This is FR-004's exemption with both of its conditions and no wider reach. 'Changes the engine on net by nothing' becomes a no-diff over the push range under l7r/, which is FR-004's own definition. It refuses on nothing beyond what FR-004 refuses on, and on no time (FR-007).

decisions.summary: Docs: a 'The trial form' section in spec-kit-and-reviews.md, one line in the root CLAUDE.md workflow list, and the trial rule in guards.md
decisions.why: This is FR-006 item for item.

decisions.summary: perf_share.py sits beside perf_profile.py in l7r/diagram/tools/; Makefile targets perf-share and trial; perf-profile bookends are none
decisions.why: File placement. It changes no requested behavior, and no roll's engine code changes.

decisions.summary: T01 is done when make perf-share PROFILES=<437's four> reproduces 437's 3.5%
decisions.why: This checks SC-001 for the requested command. It measures nothing the GM did not ask about.

decisions.summary: T02 is done when hooks-test passes the gate's new cases and the next feature (the search-restructuring trial) is started with make trial
decisions.why: The GM's request says to build the trial form, then do the search-restructuring trial. Starting that trial with the new form is the next step the request names. It does not narrow the request.

decisions.summary: A trial measured first and reviewed once, its evidence pushed as it is measured.
decisions.why: Restates the GM-endorsed proposal (a) verbatim in substance: 'measure first under a short brief, then one spec review on fixed evidence'.

decisions.summary: The trial rule is placed in review-gate.sh's spec loop, the one place a verdict is required at push.
decisions.why: Implements FR-004 where the verdict requirement lives; it adds no reach beyond FR-004's exemption (verdict-less brief, not Done, engine unchanged on net) and FR-007 holds: the conditions are status and engine delta, not time.

decisions.summary: After T01.
decisions.why: Sequencing only; the GM asked for both (a) and (c) built first, in no stated order.

decisions.summary: Green: landed with the gate's hook tests and trial-start's tests; red: failure recorded, task set down, a cannot-be-done claim ruled through make arbiter-ask.
decisions.why: Process exits; nothing dropped from FR-003/FR-004.

decisions.summary: Done measured as make hooks-test passing the gate's new cases and feature 439 started with make trial.
decisions.why: Starting the search-restructuring trial with the new tool is the GM's stated next step ('Then do the search-restructuring trial'); only its claim/brief is in this task, the trial itself stays its own feature.

decisions.summary: The brief measured by tests/test_trial_start.py, the gate rule by tests/hooks/test-review-gate.sh.
decisions.why: Tests whose only effect is to enforce FR-003 (SC-002) and FR-004 (SC-003): enforcement of the request, not unrequested scope.

decisions.summary: Constraints cited: FR-001, FR-002, FR-007, D1, D2; nothing in them is dropped or bounded by the block.
